headline: Bank of America (BAC) Signals OCC Penalties Over Anti Money Laundering Deficiencies
summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) disclosed that it may face monetary penalties tied to deficiencies in its anti money laundering program. The bank indicated that a resolution with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, or OCC, could be near. This disclosure marks a change from earlier statements that suggested any regulatory outcome was not expected to have a material financial impact.
